desc: Derive the equivalence between valid colorings, nonincreasing row thresholds, and column prefixes.
Translate fixed black/white cells into row-threshold inequalities and prove sufficiency.
Design the sparse \(O(M\log M)\) feasibility check.
Prove correctness for unmentioned rows and boundary thresholds \(0,N\).
Implement and validate the algorithm against all samples and edge cases.
